title: Spicy Kielbasa Tagine
description: A unique and flavorful tagine dish made with spicy kielbasa sausage, served in a traditional Indian-style stew.

ingredients.name: zesty
ingredients.notes: such as red onion or scallions

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers or carrots

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or clay tagine over medium heat.
Add kielbasa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add zesty, tagine, and canadian, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
